title: Hill Realm
description: A powerful mountain-themed mod adding tools, armor, food, and a new mob to Minecraft.
body:
# Hill_Realm

Explore the power of the mountains! Hill_Realm adds a complete set of mountain-themed content to Minecraft 1.21.1.

## 🏔️ Features

### Items & Materials
- **Hill Crystal** - A rare crystal found deep underground
- **Hill Ingot** - Crafted from 9 Hill Crystals, used for crafting gear

### ⚔️ Tools & Armor
- **Hill Tools** - Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe (stronger than Netherite!)
- **Hill Armor** - Full armor set with high protection and toughness

### 🍎 Food
- **Hill Apple** - Grants Speed, Jump Boost, Strength, Resistance, Regeneration, and Health Boost for 2.5 minutes

### 🧱 Blocks & Ore
- **Hill Block** - Decorative block crafted from 9 Hill Ingots
- **Hill Ore** - Generates between Y -60 and Y 0, drops Hill Crystal

### 👾 Mob
- **Hill** - A new mob to discover in your world

## 📦 Recipes
- 5 Iron Ingots → 1 Hill Crystal
- 9 Hill Crystals → 1 Hill Ingot  
- 9 Hill Ingots → 1 Hill Block
- Smelt Hill Ore → Hill Ingot

## 🌍 Languages
- English (US)
- 中文 (Chinese Simplified)

## 📋 Requirements
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
- **Java:** 21
- **Dependencies:** Fabric API

## 💻 Source Code

https://github.com/PandaSX100/Hill-Realm

**Enjoy exploring the mountains!**
